newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-Taranaki beats Argentina 26-10.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-Taranaki beats Argentina 26-10.

text.p: The touring Argentinian rugby team suffered further humiliation on Tuesday when Taranaki beat them 26-10 in New Plymouth.
The lowly-rated first division provincial side scored four tries to one, handing the Pumas another defeat to follow their 93-8 hiding by the All Blacks in the first test last Saturday.
Taranaki led 14-10 at halftime, with centre Mark Robinson and flanker Kevin Barrett each scoring a try. Jason Holland converted both.
The tourists' points came from a try by winger Diego Albanese and a penalty and conversion by Jose Cilley.
A solid Taranaki defence kept the disorganised Pumas from adding to their points.
Meanwhile, the home side finished with a flourish, adding a try each by wingers Lea Potaufa and Filipo Toala, and Holland kicking a conversion.
Argentina travel to Hamilton the second test, the last match of their five-game tour.
